description: Dock a SMILES ligand into a receptor PDB; returns ranked poses and docking confidence. DiffDock v1.1 portable adapter; receptor PDB plus inline ligand SMILES.

ligand.description: Ligand SMILES, not an uploaded ligand path.

anyOf.description: Inline PDB containing ATOM records; 40–2,000,000 UTF-8 bytes (runtime checked).
Tenant-owned artifact reference. Upload and finalize the bytes before submitting this model call.

artifact_id.description: Caller-owned immutable artifact UUID returned after upload finalization.

compression.description: Artifact input must be stored without transport compression.

media_type.description: Media type of the uploaded bytes.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact uploaded bytes.

protein.description: Inline PDB containing ATOM records; 40–2,000,000 UTF-8 bytes (runtime checked). Prefer an artifact reference for nontrivial files so clients never serialize file bytes through an LLM.

steps.description: Sampling steps, no greater than time_divisions.

time_divisions.description: Diffusion time divisions; must be >= steps.

output_prefix.description: Directory in your assigned bucket for automatic result.json, artifacts and manifest.json delivery. Defaults to runs/<model-id>; the operation ID is appended. Never sent to the model.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse this key with identical inputs after a lost response.

wait_seconds.description: Wait at most this many seconds; otherwise poll the returned operation ID.
